function: Adaptive eigenvector-based CSI feedback: BiLSTM autoencoder compresses and recovers downlink CSI for variable subband counts and feedback bits, with UE-first separate training (p. 1-2, 4).
system: FDD massive MIMO-OFDM downlink, NT=32 gNB antennas, NR=4 UE antennas, K=3, 6, 12 subbands; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (p. 1, 3, 8).
method: BiLSTM autoencoder (ABLNet) with feedback-bit control unit and bit-adjusting algorithm; unsupervised reconstruction with SGCS loss; UE-first separate training (p. 4-8).
data_channel: 3GPP CDL-A and CDL-C channels, 30 ns delay spread, simulated by the authors; 50,000 training and 1000 test eigenvectors per subband number (p. 8).
test_conditions: Same CDL channel for training and testing, K=3, 6, 12 and feedback-bit ranges all seen in training; separate-training tests mix CDL-A and CDL-C across UEs (p. 5, 8, 12).
baselines: Learned: EVCsiNet [20], Transformer [21], own fixed-K BiLSTMNet, multi-decoder versions; non-learned: enhanced Type II (eTypeII) scheme (p. 9-10).
metrics: SGCS, CDF of SGCS, link-level BLER versus SNR, feedback bits, trainable parameters, FLOPs (p. 8-10).
complexity: Table II: ABLNet 14.75e6 parameters and 32.40e7 FLOPs; EVCsiNet 6.98e6 and 1.41e7; Transformer 23.95e6 and 51.29e7 (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 8: "The clustered delay line (CDL) channel model defined in" the 3GPP is adapted to generate the data samples, with CDLA and CDLC at 30 ns delay spread.
q2_support: p. 5: "eigenvectors with multiple subband numbers are trained at the" same time, so K=3, 6, 12 are all in training; p. 8: "At the same time, the sizes of training and testing data" come from the same CDL channel; no unseen scenario, band, dataset or antenna number is tested.
q3_support: p. 9: "model, different comparison models, such as EVCsiNet" and Transformer [20], [21] are the earlier learned baselines (SGCS, Figs. 7-8); p. 10: "i.e., eTypeII, the number Q = {49, 87, 130} of feedback bits" is the non-learned baseline compared on BLER (Fig. 11).
q4_support: p. 9: "as listed in Table II, the model complexity of" different schemes is given in trainable parameters and FLOPs (ABLNet 14.75e6 parameters, 32.40e7 FLOPs).
q5_support: p. 8: "The clustered delay line (CDL) channel model defined in" the 3GPP is used to generate the data samples with the authors' own simulator; no code or data link, DOI, public dataset or measured data is given.
notes: Included as area 2 (CSI feedback, downlink eigenvector compression and recovery). Table I (p. 8) and Table II (p. 9) were read from the page images because the text extraction lost them. q2 is 0 because the ABLNet is trained jointly over K=3, 6, 12 and the FBCU over the bit range and tested on those same settings; the separate-training runs mix CDL-A and CDL-C across UEs, but the paper does not test a model on a channel it was not trained on. q3 is 1 through EVCsiNet and Transformer (learned) and eTypeII (non-learned, BLER on p. 10).
